# PageLabel

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines the numbering style and optional prefix applied to a range of pages.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PageLabel(options?: PageLabelOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`prefix`](#prefix): Optional label prefix, prepended to every page label (e.g. `'A-'` → A-1, A-2).
- [`startAt`](#startat): First value in the sequence.
- [`style`](#style): Numbering style.

### `prefix`

```typescript
prefix?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional label prefix, prepended to every page label (e.g. `'A-'` → A-1, A-2).

### `startAt`

```typescript
startAt: number
```

First value in the sequence. Defaults to `1`.

Example, from `code-recipes/long-form-typesetting/book-page-layout`:

```typescript
pageLabel.startAt = 42;
```

### `style`

```typescript
style: PageLabelStyle
```

Numbering style. Defaults to `'decimal'`.
